title: The watch
goals: Do not let Dask see you.
starting_code:
# Wait only if Dask looks this way, then cross.
wizard.move_up(2)
hints: Look at the start card: the level is played two ways, and one program must get through both.
Ask which way Dask looks before you move: `dask.facing == "left"` is `True` when he looks this way.
Under the `if`, moved in by four spaces, wait one tick.
intro: I walk this corridor every night. Sometimes I look your way, sometimes I do not. Cross when I am not looking, if you can.
